parts.label: Ocean plate
parts.note: Thin, heavy crust under the sea

parts.label: Continental plate
parts.note: Thick, lighter crust that makes the land

parts.label: Trench
parts.note: A deep valley in the sea floor where the plate dives

parts.label: Subduction
parts.note: The ocean plate sinks into the mantle and melts

parts.label: Volcano
parts.note: Melted rock rises up to make volcanoes

parts.label: Mountains
parts.note: The crust crumples up as the plates push

parts.label: Mantle
parts.note: Hot, slowly flowing rock that carries the plates
